::: {#def-partial-f-test}
#### Partial F-test

Let a smaller linear regression model be [nested](#def-nested-regression-models)
in a larger model with $p$ features,
so that they differ by $q$ coefficients,
and let both be fitted by [ordinary least squares](#def-ols) to $n$ observations.
Write $\text{RSS}_0$ and $\text{RSS}_1$ for the
[residual sums of squares](#def-rss) of the smaller and the larger fit.
The **partial F-test** of

$$
\begin{aligned}
  H_0: \text{the } q \text{ coefficients are all } 0
\end{aligned}
$$

uses the statistic

$$
F \eqdef \frac{(\text{RSS}_0 - \text{RSS}_1) / q}{\text{RSS}_1 / (n - p - 1)}.
$$

Its p-value is $\Pr(F^* \ge F)$,
where $F^*$ has the $F_{q,\, n-p-1}$ distribution ([F-distribution](inference.qmd#def-f-dist)).

Source: @vittinghoff2e [Section 4.3] and @dobson4e [Section 6.3].
:::
